description: A short explainer about managing a free trial that renews automatically.

segments.text: Your free trial may end not on the sign-up date, but on a hidden renewal or cancellation cutoff.
segments.visual_intent: A subscription trial card with a calendar showing a date and a small icon indicating automatic renewal if enabled.

segments.text: Check the trial agreement for the renewal price and note the cutoff date where you can cancel before automatic renewal starts.
segments.visual_intent: The same trial card now has a highlighted cutoff date and a calendar with a new event marked.

segments.text: Set a reminder a few days before the cutoff date to decide whether to keep or cancel the service.
segments.visual_intent: Calendar with a reminder set earlier than the cutoff date, and the trial card showing a keep/cancel choice.

segments.text: Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.
segments.visual_intent: Trial card with a confirmation message showing a deliberate choice and a clear final state.

title: Your free trial has a second deadline
